build_mmf_transformer_from_params: build an MMFTransformer model from modality configs with image and text modalities using from_params
build_mmf_transformer_with_resnet: build an MMFTransformer model with a ResNet152 image encoder and identity text encoder
test_mmf_transformer_torchscript: test that an MMFTransformer model can be saved and loaded as a TorchScript model
test_mmf_transformer_preprocessing: test the MMFTransformer preprocess_sample method with image and text input tensors
test_mlm_head_weight_tying: test that the MLM head decoder weights are tied to the text encoder word embeddings
